trigger.description: ee context --since was requested with a renderer that supports neither JSON envelopes nor markdown delta documents in v1, so ee returns the full rendered pack and reports that the delta optimization was skipped.
setup_commands: ee remember 'Delta format unsupported fixture memory.' --workspace . --level procedural --kind fact --json
trigger.invocation: ee context 'delta format unsupported fixture' --workspace . --since <prior-pack-hash> --format toon

expected_emission.repair_string: Use `ee pack "<task>" --since <pack-hash> --json` for JSON context deltas, `--format markdown` for a markdown delta, or omit --since.
